research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Datadog is researching systems such as Time-Series Optimized Transformer for Observability to process multivariate time series, Detecting Faulty Deployments Using Weak Supervision to quickly flag bad software releases, and Vulnerability Detection And Smart Remediation Using Runtime Data to build enriched runtime dependency trees. It also develops Duplication Avoidance For Mutable Event Based Metrics and a Protocol for correlating user space data with kernel space data, advancing observability, deployment quality, security, metrics, and low level monitoring.

about_short_description.short_description: Datadog is an observability and security platform that offers infrastructure, applications, software development, and monitoring services.

product.name: Datadog Observability and Security Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that unifies infrastructure, application, log, security, digital experience, software delivery, and service management data in one environment.

product.name: Infrastructure Monitoring
product.description: Monitors the health, performance, and resource utilization of hosts, cloud services, containers, Kubernetes environments, serverless workloads, storage, and GPUs.

product.name: Application Performance Monitoring (APM)
product.description: Traces application requests and services to identify performance issues, errors, dependencies, and causes of degraded application behavior.

product.name: Log Management
product.description: Collects, indexes, analyzes, and explores logs to support troubleshooting, operational monitoring, compliance activities, and security investigations.

product.name: Datadog Security
product.description: Provides application, cloud, workload, and threat monitoring capabilities for identifying vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, suspicious activity, and security incidents.

product.name: Digital Experience Monitoring
product.description: Measures frontend and mobile application performance and user journeys through real-user, synthetic, session-replay, product-analytics, and application-testing capabilities.
